metadata.description: Skills for working with singlerpc — a local JSON-RPC proxy for many EVM chains with load balancing, failover, and a one-call cross-chain contract lookup.

plugins.name: singlerpc-skill
plugins.description: Bootstraps singlerpc when missing, runs it in the background when present, and teaches Claude Code the JSON-RPC routing pattern plus the sr_contract_chains cross-chain address lookup.
